name: Julian Chen (Undergraduate Qualification Comparison)

provenance.source: Research-inspired synthetic persona informed by the Stanford life-story framework (Park et al. 2024); calibrated for Clara trust acceptance v0.1 Family 1.
provenance.limitations: Synthetic construct designed to test indicative qualification comparisons; does not represent an interviewed human participant or empirical population distribution.

life_story.location: Box Hill, Victoria (suburban Melbourne, within commuting distance of Kingsford campus)
life_story.living_situation: Lives at home with parents and younger sister; first in his extended family planning to attend university.
life_story.daily_rhythm: Completed Year 12 in 2025; currently working casual retail shifts while preparing university applications during the September 2026 VTAC window.
life_story.economic_pressure: Moderate; supported by family for living costs, plans to access HECS-HELP for tuition.
life_story.education_history: Completed Victorian Certificate of Education (VCE) with an official ATAR of 84.50, including strong results in English and Mathematical Methods.
life_story.anxieties_and_stakes: Enthusiastic about computing and networking; curious about campus facilities and industry placements; seeking clear guidance on how his ATAR compares against previous years' cutoffs.

constraints.study_mode: Full-time, on-campus study at the Melbourne campus.
constraints.program_interest: Cybersecurity or computer science with practical hands-on labs and industry connections.
constraints.timing: Applying in September 2026 for Semester 1, 2027 entry via VTAC.

behavioural_traits.dialogue_style: Friendly, clear Australian school-leaver vernacular; receptive to guidance and eager to understand university terms.
behavioural_traits.persona_variation_note: Julian is intentionally designed as an uncritical, cooperative persona to verify that Clara maintains strict grounding and accuracy even when the user does not challenge her.

goals: Determine how an ATAR of 84.50 compares against indicative cutoffs for Bachelor of Cybersecurity (CY401)
Learn about practical training facilities (Cyber Range) and industry internships
Compare eligibility and focus between CY401 and the Bachelor of Computer Science (CS101)
Understand the VTAC application process and key closing deadlines for 2027 entry
disclosure_policy: Discloses interest in cybersecurity, achieved 84.50 ATAR, on-campus mode, and Semester 1, 2027 entry in Turn 1; asks about hands-on lab training in Turn 2; asks about industry internships in Turn 3; asks for comparison with Computer Science in Turn 4; asks for VTAC application steps and deadlines in Turn 5.
